summary.text: Molly Cook, a Democrat, represents Texas Senate District 15 and has served in the Senate since 2024. She is a registered nurse and grassroots organizer from the Houston area.

paragraphs.text: Cook is a sixth-generation Texan who earned a nursing degree from the University of Texas at Austin and a combined nursing and public health graduate degree from Johns Hopkins University.
Her official profile says her community advocacy helped pass a citizen-driven amendment to the City of Houston charter.
